rollback.justification: The companion rollback drill ran on 2026-08-01T17:23:24Z and passed; its own dated artifact carries it. It was NOT re-run on 2026-08-04. What happened instead is narrower and machine-observed: the chained consumer save removed and re-added the chart instances and repaired all 118 bindings, and the later verify run found every binding correct with no unknown-parent runtime error. That exercises re-binding after an instance is re-created; it is not the drill's controlled remove / reload / verify-Suite-only / restore sequence, and it is not recorded as one.
